done_when: Forge's AGENTS.md has a '## Review rules' section, outside the Forge-managed block, with one rule: a change to what a coordinator or worker should do or can use (a command, an option, a setting, a step in the flow) updates src/forge/templates/skill.md or the worker brief in the same change, and the review reports a missing update as P1.
why: Forge changes how coordinators and workers should act without updating the skill that client repos get, so agents there don't use new features; Forge's own repo has no review rule that catches it
